(quote per base)   P_0          = (Q_C + Q_L) / B_0       (open price)   P_liq(t)     = Q_owed(t) / B_0        = currentLiquidationPrice()   r(t)         = R(t) / SECONDS_PER_YEAR (per-second rate in ray)   R(t)         = rateBps / 10_000        (APR as fraction)   I(t)         = integral[t_open..t] r(u) du  (dimensionless accum. interest) ──────────────────── Interest model (modular) ──────────────────────   The interest math is inherited from InterestModel (see import).   Switch between the three models by changing a single import line above.   1. Simple interest  (tex sec. 4.1):        C(t) = integral[0..t] r(u) du          (global additive accumulator)        Q_I(t) = Q_L * (C(t) - C(t_open))   2.
